scope: Adopted 206-input native app build and separately bound focused component checks; no fresh full suite or proof claim.
implementation: Application logic, UI, parsing, storage policy, tests and benchmarks remain Bend 2. SQLite and its narrow bridge are the maintained native exception. TypeScript GC code is development compiler tooling only.

source.closure_hash_format: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: content SHA256, two spaces, repository-relative path, newline

mac_build.frontend: Original pinned CLI/main plus maintained exact-hash-guarded GC512 preload; no diagnostic telemetry or relocated compiler copy.
mac_build.compiler_boundary: Upstream source files on disk are unchanged; the loaded compiler receives the GC-only in-memory hook. No application/runtime algorithm is moved into this adapter.
mac_build.native_compiler: mise-managed LLVM 23.1.4, -O1, macOS 26 target, macOS 27 SDK
mac_build.timing_scope: Build diagnostics only; no application speedup or literal full-app C equivalence to the original unmodified frontend is claimed.

usage.scope: Separately frozen compile-fix-v3 component. Parse/type completion followed by unsafe/foreign verdicts is not a proof pass; later all five compiled native tests passed.

cancellation_app_events.scope: Actual Bend A.event cancellation sends to the exact worker, keeps the reply channel open until its cleanup acknowledgment, then closes it. This component test does not establish a native macOS window Close bound.
cancellation_app_events.prior_timeout: Initial 600-second native compile timeout is preserved; the same generated C passed a bounded 1800-second continuation without source, flags or memory-guard changes.

event_seal_bytes.scope: Byte-codec correctness; canonical field tags, order, escapes, separators and old seed behavior retained.

event_seal_preservation.collector_correction: All four native executables exited 0. The original collector miscounted the unchanged literal crash-suite footer. An additive read-only collector accepted the existing 1203 PASS lines plus that footer; no source, assertion or executable was changed or rerun.
event_seal_preservation.binding_limit: The crash C/binary hashes were bound after execution because the original collector failed before persisting them. The first three tests retained durable pre/post artifact hashes; do not claim that stronger binding for the fourth.

matched_backend_pair.host: Same physical Apple M2 Pro Mac, 32 GiB, macOS 27.0.1 arm64; Tart stopped; no overlapping owned compile
matched_backend_pair.compiler: Both variants built before measurement with pinned LLVM 23.1.4 -O1; same runtime path and synthetic fixture
matched_backend_pair.integrity: Both quick checks and foreign-key checks passed; exact fixture bytes, both snapshot seals, typed event/context prefixes and 100000 prior raw IDs matched.
matched_backend_pair.scope: One matched backend pair for the separate byte-encoder component. Append was modestly faster; unchanged refresh was slower. No significance, solved-append, complete-app performance or Swift comparison claim.

test_discovery.verification: Shell runner exercised with a build stub; this verifies discovery only and is not a Bend compilation or assertion result.

publication_safety: Synthetic technical metadata and hashes only; no private history, screenshot pixels, database, private source, advisor log or absolute host paths.
